The '''Loronar Corporation''' was a company that produced various technological products. These included [[Mk. III Optimized Galven Coils]], a model of [[starship]] [[laser focusing array]], and the [[Model 4 Hostile Environment Treatment]], a model of [[radiation shielding]] for [[armor]]. Both products were available during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SM" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Loronar Corporation was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' supplement ''[[Special Modifications]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="SM" /> The company originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'', a [[1989]] roleplaying supplement written by [[Greg Gorden]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GFT">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref>
